text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 8. Application Essay 800 words or so in Chinese, regarding major of application and desired direction of study
